name: ship-fleet
description: Backlog-wide feature-delivery orchestrator: surveys everything remaining in a repo's pipeline (specs, plans, briefs, mocks, worktrees, deferred follow-ups), writes ORCHESTRATOR.md and a visual hierarchy before any execution, then conducts dependency-ordered ship-feature runners under a global agent budget - with per-item cross-family verification, serialized merges, executor-lane routing, and a ledger a fresh session can resume the whole fleet from.
